lines.text: Each of you sets aside income on the first day of every week, and recommended people carry it to Antioch.
Paul will come after going through Macedonia, and he hopes to spend some time with you if the Lord permits.
Paul will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost because a great door for effective work has opened to him.
Paul asks that Timothy have nothing to fear with you, and he strongly urged Apollos to go to you.
Stephanas and his household were the first converts in Achaia, and Stephanas, Fortunatus and Achaicus tested Paul's spirit.
